harm_review.reason: Keep existing financial and operational S2 unchanged pending attribution and functional evidence. Fifteen AI-assisted openings are actual identity-workflow failures; missing net loss does not erase that fact. HK$860,000 credit/card activity and HK$1.2m suspected proceeds cover thirty opened accounts, not the fifteen AI-assisted subset. Neither AI-attributed realised loss nor a readily-remediable economic endpoint is independently established. The non-USD S2 low/remediable and S3 material/bounded livelihood or organisational loss alternatives were explicitly tested; total syndicate money movement is not their functional endpoint. The operational basis asserts routine recovery, but source evidence establishes investigation/seizure/advice rather than completed workflow recovery. Lost identity cards establish actual misuse, while AI-specific subjects/data consequences remain unallocated. This is an attribution/functional blocker, not a withdrawal for missing monetary figures, incomplete follow-up or later reassignment.

fc_086_087_review.basis: Professional identity/authority impersonation and algorithmic commercial pricing do not evidence an intimate-role claim, exclusive caregiving or an asserted priority over real-world partners. No relational escalation with boundary-preserving continuation supports success.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: No intimacy-bearing relational-authority assertion, real-world partner priority or material boundary distortion is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: No material exclusive-role or relational escalation challenge and observed boundary-preserving response is evidenced.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Professional impersonation, routine assistance and access dependence do not by themselves establish privileged intimate authority.

fc_086_087_review.basis: Neither ordinary economic inducement, NDA confidentiality, hiring nor a sensitive institutional identity establishes an independently applicable heightened personal duty and reasonably available capacity/distress/dependency signals in the governed response. No material protective-response omission is independently established. General fraud/moderation controls remain separately adjudicated; nonactivation is not inferred.
fc_086_087_review.failure_test: The independent context/person/time duty, sufficiently visible heightened-risk signals and materially omitted bounded response are not established together.
fc_086_087_review.success_test: Ordinary repair, refusal, seizure or human recovery is not evidence of an engaged heightened personal-protection duty being discharged by the AI.
fc_086_087_review.exclusions_test: Neither adverse consequences nor commercial dependency establish personal vulnerability. No available-control nonactivation is inferred from absence of protection.

evidence_search.notes: Preserved contemporaneous police-briefing reports and original HK01 endpoint re-examined. Later 2026 government account is a separate case and excluded. No application-by-application loss or repair ledger obtained.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Fifteen AI-assisted applications passed remote verification and produced accounts in other people’s names, making the accepted verification state operative account-opening authority.
Lost-card portraits were used to create identity-bound composites without holder authority, treating possession of the source identity material as sufficient transformation authority.
The scheme used AI-assisted identity to obtain financial access, but the evidence does not tie a specific AI-assisted account to a solicitation or attempted transfer of economic value.

evidence_to_governance_review.external_requirements: Existing false-representation and identity-evidence reliance findings retained; security workaround does not independently prove unavailable protection or failed moderation.
